description: DB integration: migration on a seeded tenant creates checkouts, backfills open and closed asset_assignments rows with dates/actors/source intact, and sets holder_kind/holder_id; re-running is a no-op

DB integration: on-loan stock units backfill to client-holder checkouts with due dates; loanOut with a contact and loanReturn go through the engine and keep stock_units mirrored; loaners-out report reads the ledger

DB integration: checkOut/checkIn of an asset to each holder kind writes the ledger, current-holder columns, location (for location holders) and asset_history, and check-in applies the default available status
DB integration guard: second open checkout is refused, transfer succeeds atomically, and the partial unique index rejects a raw duplicate open asset checkout

Unit: holder validation rejects wrong-client contact/location/client for client-owned items, accepts any client's contact/location/client for MSP-owned items, rejects shared mailbox, inactive user, self holder and asset cycles
DB integration: dock out to laptop out to contact resolves contact_name_id on both; checking the laptop in to a location clears the dock's effective contact; portal visibility follows

DB integration: legacy callers (form update, bulk update, REST PUT contact_name_id, RMM auto-assign, bundle owner change, import applier) produce ledger rows with the right source and keep asset_assignments in step
Unit: engine publishes ASSET_CHECKED_OUT/ASSET_CHECKED_IN and ASSET_ASSIGNED/ASSET_UNASSIGNED with holder kind as owner type after commit, and nothing on rollback
Integration: assignAssetContact (Identity tile) and bulk check out emit ASSET_ASSIGNED
Permissions: check out/in is refused without asset:update and for an asset outside the user's record-level update scope

Playwright: technician checks an asset out to a user with expected check-in and note from the holder row, sees the chip and due date, checks it in with a condition note and status, and the Checkouts panel shows the stay
Playwright: asset list Held by/Due columns and overdue filter show a past-due checkout; bulk check out to a location and bulk check in update all selected
Playwright: asset form and quick-add holder field checks out to an asset holder; drawer, client tab and contact page show the chip
Integration: settings defaults (checkout period, requires-acceptance) apply in the dialog and engine; settings tab saves them
Integration: asset.checkin_due emits once at lead time and once at due date for a checkout, not again on rescan, re-arms after the expected date changes, and loaner checkouts appear overdue

DB integration: acceptance engine creates request and hashed link, rejects expired/revoked/reused tokens, records one decision with ip/user agent/agreement hash, and acceptance_decisions refuses update on plain Postgres

Playwright: checkout with requires-acceptance sends an email (MailHog/emulator) whose link opens /accept/[token]; accepting sets accepted, stores the receipt document on asset and contact, and publishes CHECKOUT_ACCEPTED
Integration: decline keeps checkout open as declined, notifies the MSP user in-app; MSP mark-accepted and resend work
Integration: receipt emails go to contact and user holders only when tenant-enabled and requested, use tenant override templates when present, and are not sent to location/asset holders
Integration: reminder and overdue emails are sent from asset.checkin_due emissions; template seed exists for every supported locale
DB integration: license seat checkout to contact, user and asset holders; refuses beyond seat count; non-reassignable refuses check-in
Integration: product key is stored via secret provider, masked in list/detail API, and revealed only with license:update; license RBAC enforced on CRUD
Playwright: create a license, check seats out from the detail screen, see used/total and seat on the contact Equipment section
Integration: license.expiration emits at lead time and expiration

DB integration: accessory checkout from a client stock location decrements on-hand with issue_out, partial check-in splits and returns stock with issue_in; consumable issue decrements and records a closed row; component install and removal move stock to and from an asset
DB integration guard: concurrent product checkouts cannot drive on-hand negative
Playwright: admin creates a client stock location and accessory product, then checks 2 out to a contact from the client Assets tab and sees counts update
Playwright: printable equipment-held sheet for a contact lists assets, seats and accessories

Playwright (portal): contact sees My equipment with an effectively held asset, an MSP-owned loaner checked out to them and a pending acceptance, accepts inline; a contact-scope peer cannot see it; a client-scope user also sees location-held items
Playwright (portal + MSP): requestable asset offered in an Equipment service-request field; fulfilling the request checks it out to the requester with source request
Integration (portal): client-scope user sees the read-only checkout ledger without commercial fields
Playwright: Checkouts ledger filters to overdue and exports CSV with display names only
API contract: checkouts REST endpoints check out, patch due date, check in and list with filters; assignments endpoint keeps its response shape from the ledger
Mobile: asset detail shows holder/due/acceptance and scan check-in closes the checkout
Integration: CSV import with holder email/location columns checks assets out; export includes holder and due columns
Integration: Snipe-IT connector against a recorded API fixture (emulator) previews mappings and applies hardware, users, locations, statuses, licenses, stock and open checkouts with dates preserved
Integration: Snipe-IT history imports as closed ledger rows and a second apply creates no duplicates
Docs check: user-facing pages exist for checkouts, acceptance, licenses, stock pools, portal equipment and Snipe-IT import, with screenshots
Integration: with asset-checkout off, the asset page and list show the existing Assign UI and portal has no My equipment; with it on, the new surfaces render
Playwright: create an MSP-owned asset under the tenant's own client, check it out to an MSP user, then transfer it as a loaner to another client's contact; the holder chip and ledger show both stays
